accounting.note: The original 5 m sequence did not qualify: first RF frame completed, receiver acquisition became incomplete at the next LOAD, and two original slots were not transmitted. A separately planned three-frame waveform-equivalent diagnostic provides the accepted 5 m sequence; one FSKCW diagnostic follows its preserved RENEW-timeout observer abort.

limits: Exact two conducted points on Pico A, unfiltered attenuator/combiner path.
Receiver audio conditions are part of WSPR acceptance; nominal failures remain.
No calibrated absolute RF/time/power, LPF, antenna, both-board or alternate-clock qualification.
